clinic.name: North Shore Smile Surgery

treatmentJourney.title: Consultation & Assessment
treatmentJourney.description: Our journey begins with a thorough consultation, including 3D x-rays and digital impressions, to assess each wisdom tooth and understand your unique needs.

treatmentJourney.title: Sedation Planning & Review
treatmentJourney.description: We'll discuss your sedation options and conduct a pre-operative medical review to ensure your safety and comfort during the wisdom teeth removal procedure.

treatmentJourney.title: The Procedure
treatmentJourney.description: Your wisdom teeth removal will be performed in our accredited surgical suite, utilizing advanced technology and your chosen sedation for a comfortable experience.

treatmentJourney.title: Immediate Post-Op Monitoring
treatmentJourney.description: Following your procedure, our team will provide immediate post-operative monitoring and clear discharge instructions to guide your initial recovery at home.

treatmentJourney.title: Guided Recovery: First 72 Hours
treatmentJourney.description: We provide dedicated support for the first 72 hours of your recovery, with our team on call to address any concerns and ensure a smooth healing process.

treatmentJourney.title: Follow-Up & Next Steps
treatmentJourney.description: A follow-up appointment will confirm clean healing and address any remaining questions, discussing next steps for your continued oral health.

whyChoosePillars.title: Board-Certified Surgeons
whyChoosePillars.description: Oral & maxillofacial surgeons with the training to handle even the most complex impacted cases safely.

whyChoosePillars.title: Real Sedation Options
whyChoosePillars.description: Nitrous, oral, or IV sedation administered by anesthesia-trained specialists — not just numbing shots.

whyChoosePillars.title: Predictable Recovery
whyChoosePillars.description: Most patients eat soft food the same evening and are back to normal life within 3-4 days.

whyChoosePillars.title: On-Call Support
whyChoosePillars.description: Our team is reachable after the procedure if you have questions during your recovery.

implantOptions.title: Impacted Wisdom Teeth Removal
implantOptions.description: Safely removes wisdom teeth trapped beneath the gums or jawbone to prevent pain, infection, and damage to nearby teeth.

implantOptions.title: Surgical Tooth Extractions
implantOptions.description: Expert surgical removal of complex or partially erupted wisdom teeth using advanced techniques for optimal healing.

implantOptions.title: Sedation Dentistry
implantOptions.description: Comfort-focused sedation options, including IV sedation and nitrous oxide, for a relaxed, stress-free procedure.

implantOptions.title: Emergency Wisdom Tooth Care
implantOptions.description: Prompt treatment for severe pain, swelling, infection, or other urgent wisdom tooth complications.

implantOptions.title: Bone Grafting & Socket Preservation
implantOptions.description: Helps preserve jawbone structure and supports future restorative treatment when needed after extraction.

implantOptions.title: Post-Extraction Recovery & Aftercare
implantOptions.description: Personalized recovery guidance to promote healing, minimize discomfort, and reduce the risk of complications.

doctor.name: Dr. Scott Frank
doctor.bio: With decades of experience since opening his practice in 1988, Dr. Scott Frank is an expert in oral surgery services, including wisdom teeth removal. He has served thousands of patients in the north and northwest Chicago suburbs with compassion, dedication, and surgical excellence. Dr. Frank continually improves his knowledge through CE courses and directs the premier study club, Elite Dental Group, for dental professionals in the area. His commitment to advanced techniques and patient comfort ensures a confident smile for all.

reviews.name: Gwen Smoot
reviews.text: Dr. Frank is very friendly, very informative, and he made me very comfortable in a situation where I was in pain and needed to have a tooth extracted. I can say that Dr. Frank really helped me out in this situation.

reviews.name: Christine
reviews.text: I would say if you want to go to the best oral surgeon in Lake County, come to Dr. Frank, because he is very professional, dedicated, does perfect work, and he’s very caring and he’s a wonderful doctor and person. He follows up to make sure you're okay. Dr. Frank is the best.

reviews.name: Dr. Lynn Marie Konzen
reviews.text: I love coming to this practice because the staff is very friendly. I enjoy coming in there. They’re nice people. The atmosphere is very warm, very clean office, and of course, Dr. Frank is a very nice person. I’ve worked with him for many years and I’m also a patient of his. He makes you feel at ease.

reviews.name: Marty Singer
reviews.text: [Dr. Frank] personally called me each time I had a procedure and he seemed genuinely interested in how I was faring. He is exceptional in explaining what the procedure is going to be like. He really seems to care.

reviews.name: Anne Grego
reviews.text: From the minute I called, they made it very simple to come in and very easy for me to work with my insurance company; they did everything before I had to come. I've recommended Dr. Frank to so many people already, and they've all had good experiences too.

reviews.name: Nancy J.
reviews.text: He never gets upset, nothing seems too difficult for him. He’s always willing to see me, or any of his patients, whenever you have a problem. You never feel like you’re bothering Dr. Frank.
